instruction: Open the desktop power settings and enable automatic suspend by configuring sleep timeout to 15 minutes of inactivity.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the AC power sleep timeout to 15 minutes (900 seconds). The evaluator uses gsettings to read the sleep-inactive-ac-timeout value and expects it to be '900\n' (15 minutes). Similar to the original task which checks idle-delay setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the required state: Uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power sleep-inactive-ac-timeout' to read the AC power sleep timeout setting.
Metric performs correct comparison: Uses exact_match to verify the timeout value matches '900\n' (15 minutes = 900 seconds).
Expected value is semantically correct: '900\n' corresponds to 15 minutes (900 seconds) as required by the instruction.
Complete coverage: The instruction requires setting sleep timeout to 15 minutes when inactive, and the evaluator verifies exactly this setting.
State is accessible: The gsettings value is persistent and can be read at any time after configuration, no postconfig needed.
Logic is sound: The evaluation flow (get setting value -> compare with expected) will correctly determine task completion.
